# 🧭 Chapter 7: Portfolio Building

::: info 🎯 In this chapter
Goals, asset allocation, rebalancing and behaviour.
:::

## Units in this chapter

1. [Goals and Time Horizon](/portfolio/7.1-goals-and-time-horizon) - Learn goal-based investing, why an emergency fund comes first, and why term and health insurance precede investing.
2. [Asset Allocation](/portfolio/7.2-asset-allocation) - Understand the core idea of asset allocation, matching it to risk profile, and illustrative allocations by life stage.
3. [Diversification and Rebalancing](/portfolio/7.3-diversification-and-rebalancing) - Understand fund overlap, over-diversification, and the main methods used to rebalance a portfolio over time.
4. [Investor Behaviour](/portfolio/7.4-investor-behaviour) - Understand loss aversion, herding, FOMO and overconfidence, and how to stay disciplined during market crashes.

::: tip 📖 How to read
Go in order. Every new term is explained the first time it appears, and each unit ends with a keywords table.
:::
